description.en-US:
A local-first job tracker for contractors. No login, no cloud, no account
creation — everything is stored on your device.

* New Job wizard with clipboard-detected phone/email/address, job type, and voice or text notes
* Job dashboard with a tappable stage tracker (New through Paid)
* "I'm Here" / "I'm Gone" one-tap time tracking with automatic labor-cost calculation
* An automatic chronological timeline built from what you're already doing — no manual entry required
* Aerial roof measuring tool: trace roof sections on an aerial photo and get pitch-adjusted area straight into the job
* Photos, measurements, estimates, invoices, materials, payments, and documents per job
